typography.rules: Headings must never be pure bold; prefer regular or medium weights to maintain elegance. Tracking should be tight for large headings. Overlines must have wide tracking. Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay globally to kill digital flatness and enhance cinematic feel (opacity 2-3%).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px borders with 10-15% opacity to structure sections without heavy shadows.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use ambient diffuse shadows (e.g., shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]) for floating elements.
visual_enhancers.radius: Sharp edges (rounded-none) or very subtle (rounded-sm) for a high-end editorial feel.

component_name.navigation: Premium Glassmorphism header. Backdrop blur 24px, subtle bottom border. Desktop: full links. Mobile: elegant fullscreen menu with staggered link reveals.
component_name.buttons: Sharp rectangular buttons. Hover effect: slight scale up, background color fill from bottom or left, text color inversion. High contrast.
component_name.forms: Minimalist forms. Underline inputs (border-b only) instead of full borders. Elegant focus states.

grids.system: 12-column CSS Grid. Avoid generic 3-column equal cards. Use bento layouts or asymmetric 6/6, 7/5, 8/4 splits.
grids.showcase_grid: For venture showcase, use full-width stacked sections with sticky or parallax imagery, rather than a card grid.

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use py-24 to py-32 for section padding. Negative space is a premium design tool.
layouts.asymmetry: Offset text blocks from images. Allow images to bleed to the edge of the screen.
layouts.heroes: Full viewport (min-h-screen). Background image with gradient overlay (max 50% opacity to preserve image clarity). Central or bottom-left aligned massive typography.

motion.reveals: Framer Motion for scroll-triggered masked heading reveals (overflow-hidden, translateY 100% to 0).
motion.parallax: Subtle y-axis parallax on hero images and large background images on scroll.
motion.micro_interactions: Image scale up (1.05) on hover within an overflow-hidden container. Button arrow translations.

accessibility.contrast: All text must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1).
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query. Disable parallax and heavy transforms if true.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-button').

media.images: High-quality, art-directed photography. Consistent color grading (moody for dark themes, warm/soft for light themes).
media.video: N/A - focusing on static cinematic images.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not strictly required for this brief as art-directed 2D photography + Framer Motion parallax provides the requested cinematic editorial feel. Focus on high-end 2D DOM animation.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a premium, editorial, cinematic corporate site. Use Framer Motion for scroll reveals and Lenis for smooth scrolling. Implement dynamic CSS variables to shift the color theme per venture page (e.g., body background changes from Parent Dark to Trust Light). Follow the component spacing and negative space rules religiously. Do not use standard Shadcn card layouts; build custom raw HTML/Tailwind asymmetric layouts for the venture showcase. All forms must be frontend validation only with explicit demo state. All placeholders must remain visibly placeholders.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: 1. Do not converge toward generic outputs; avoid AI slop. 2. Implement deep layered design with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism. 3. NEVER apply universal transition (`transition: all`). 4. DO NOT center align the app container. 5. Use modern buttons. 6. Provide micro-animations for all interactions. 7. Use 2-3x more spacing than comfortable. 8. ALL unverified details must be placeholders. 9. Create .js files, not .tsx. 10. Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements.
